# Decision Document Checklist: Design directions for the portfolio

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements make the three directions distinct and judgeable and that the decision document is self-contained and lasting.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. It tests the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Distinctness of the Directions

- [x] CHK001 Is "visibly distinct" defined with the dimensions on which directions must differ (layout, story flow, comparison pattern, index structure)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is there a requirement that each direction be named and summarised so it can be told apart without opening it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-040]
- [x] CHK003 Are the four compared behaviours (stages, option comparison, demo embeds, scroll reveals) each required to be handled differently, or only described per direction? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK004 Is the constraint that all directions use the same content and existing visual resources consistent with the requirement that they look distinct? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK005 Is the fixed set of shared elements (seven stages, same options, same five index entries) stated so differences are attributable to design alone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-021]

## Judgeability

- [x] CHK006 Are the criteria Don should judge on (fit with site identity, clarity of options, effort to build, accessibility risk) stated or only implied? [Gap]
- [x] CHK007 Is "trade-offs" specified with a minimum content (cost, risk, what the direction does poorly)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040]
- [x] CHK008 Is the requirement for each direction to state whether demos are embedded or linked comparable across directions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK009 Is the disclosure of new colours, typefaces or resources defined for the case where a direction needs none? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005, §User Story 4]
- [x] CHK010 Can SC-004 ("under 30 minutes, without asking how a direction behaves") be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK011 Is it required that stand-in demos, placeholder media and draft content are disclosed in the document so they are not judged as final? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK012 Is the build effort or maintenance implication of each direction a required element, given the real portfolio follows? [Gap]

## Screenshots

- [x] CHK013 Is the count of 24 images derived consistently in FR-040, User Story 4 and the clarification (3 x 2 x 2 x 2)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-040]
- [x] CHK014 Are screenshot scope rules defined (full page or viewport, reveal state, filter cleared) so images are comparable? [Ambiguity, Gap]
- [x] CHK015 Is the requirement for image alt text or captions in the document stated? [Gap]
- [x] CHK016 Is a naming or ordering convention required so each image maps to a direction, page, theme and width? [Gap, Spec §FR-042]
- [x] CHK017 Are image format and size limits stated, given they land on main permanently? [Gap, Spec §FR-042]
- [x] CHK018 Can the requirement that screenshots show every direction after prototype removal be judged without the prototypes present? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 4]

## Pinned Preview Links

- [x] CHK019 Is "the last commit that still contains the prototypes" unambiguous, including if a later commit changes a prototype? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-046]
- [x] CHK020 Is the expected lifetime of pinned preview deployments stated, with a fallback if the links stop working? [Assumption, Spec §FR-046]
- [x] CHK021 Is the required wording that the address is pinned to a commit specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-046]
- [x] CHK022 Is the pinned address required per direction and per page (story and index)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-040]
- [x] CHK023 Is the ordering problem (the pinned commit exists only after the document is written) acknowledged with a requirement for how it is resolved? [Gap, Spec §FR-046]

## Decision Section and Removal

- [x] CHK024 Is "left empty" defined (heading only, or a template prompt) and is a prompt permitted? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-041]
- [x] CHK025 Is the prohibition on choosing a direction consistent with the need for judging criteria and trade-offs? [Conflict, Spec §FR-041, §FR-040]
- [x] CHK026 Is the document required to be readable standalone, with no dependency on the specs folder or running prototypes? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 4]
- [x] CHK027 Does prototype removal explicitly include their tests, shared config edits and sitemap or test-list changes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-043]
- [x] CHK028 Can "the live site gains no new pages" be objectively measured after merge? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK029 Is the location and name of the decision document specified in the spec, or only in the plan? [Traceability, Spec §FR-040]
- [x] CHK030 Is the requirement that the PR be marked major and left for approval reconciled with the default auto-merge convention? [Consistency, Spec §FR-044]
